description: RC3.2 and RC3.3: the radiance cache's world cache, populated and resolved through the technique at 1280x720. Single bounce (multibounce off): a sunlit corner converges in its cells and probe rays to albedo/pi x E within 2%; UpdateTiles caps the sample count at 16 and its mips are 2x2 sums; ResolveCells reads a coarser mip while a cell has fewer than 16 samples; emissive hits and rays shorter than their cell skip the cache; two coloured suns average to their sum; shadow rays; the blend weight. GI-1.2 multibounce in a furnace (floor and ceiling, a shadowless sun from above): ceiling rays and cells converge to rho^2 E / (pi (1 - 0.7)) within 2%, the discard and directions match the CPU twin, the indirect value lags one frame, and with multibounce off everything reads 0. Correctness only.
